status: four-panel continuous body-mass donor-gradient test frozen after mass+x-y-time support preflight and before any donor vertical score
role: post-freeze exploratory morphology mechanism test; cannot alter v0.3.8 or generalize to Eidolon

preflight.exclusion_reason: only 1/12 kinematic-state target individuals had >=4 supported donor individuals and >=3 distinct mass distances
preflight.selection_basis: animal mass + x-y-time support only; no donor vertical predictive score used

ecological_hypothesis: If body size contributes to within-context vertical organization, other-individual vertical profiles should transfer better to targets with more similar body mass.

context_matching.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session's median primary vertical coordinate

donor_score.donor_profile: equal-session P(centered residual height | 5-km cell,state) from one other-individual donor
donor_score.baseline_profile: equal-donor average vertical profile from all other eligible donors except the focal donor and target, evaluated on the same target-supported strata; require at least two baseline donors
donor_score.target_session_support: target endpoints whose cell×state stratum is supported by both focal donor and baseline profile
donor_score.session_gain: mean log P_focal_donor - log P_baseline_other_donors on common supported target endpoints
donor_score.donor_target_gain: equal-session mean session_gain for that target-donor pair

target_statistic.statistic: Spearman rho across structurally evaluable donor individuals between absolute donor-target mass difference and donor_target_gain

panel_statistic.statistic: equal-target mean of target-level Spearman rho
panel_statistic.target_set: exact preflight-selected target individuals with valid vertical donor scores under frozen support

calibration.null: within each frozen cohort, permute animal-mass labels among eligible individuals while holding all donor-target vertical predictive scores and support fixed; recompute target rhos and equal-target panel mean
calibration.panel_pass_rule: observed equal-target mean rho < 0 and one-sided p(null <= observed) <= 0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Within the structurally evaluable four-panel subset, body-mass similarity predicts cross-individual transfer of vertical organization.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Body-mass association is context-dependent across the structurally evaluable subset.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Simple body-mass similarity is not supported as a general predictor of vertical-organization transfer in the structurally evaluable subset.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon; animal mass is not wing loading or complete morphology.

claim_boundary: Subset membership was fixed by mass+x-y-time support before donor vertical scores were opened.
Animal mass is only a morphology proxy.
Association does not establish causal morphology.
A null result does not rule out wing shape, wing loading, experience, memory or other stable traits.
stop_rule: Do not change target set, 5-km grid, speed2_turn2 state, >=50 pair support, >=4 donor minimum, >=3 mass-distance minimum, donor baseline, permutation B/seeds or pass rule after output.
If exact target n cannot be reproduced under the vertical scorer, stop and invalidate rather than retune.
